channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Bets começam a restringir cadastros após governo proibir apostas
item.description: The federal government banned, through a provisional decree (MP), the exploitation, supply, intermediation and advertising of online betting in Brazil. Platforms such as Betano, Bet365 and Superbet have already restricted new registrations and report that deposits will not be accepted, while withdrawals and bets remain available until October 5. The MP takes effect immediately, but must be approved by Congress within 120 days to become definitive.

item.title: Escudo das Américas: Flávio Bolsonaro promete adesão, enquanto especialista alerta para riscos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro promised to join the Americas Shield, a Donald Trump-led alliance targeting criminal groups like PCC and Comando Vermelho, criticizing Lula's public security policies. Experts warn of risks to Brazilian sovereignty if Washington-aligned governments conduct operations in the Amazon without national coordination.

item.title: “Tomei uma atitude muito drástica”, diz Lula sobre proibição de bets
item.description: President Lula stated that online betting has become a “disaster for the poor” and justified the ban with a “very drastic measure,” after issuing a provisional decree blocking betting platforms. He emphasized the negative impact of these practices on economically vulnerable populations.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita o novo prédio do Instituto Federal de São Paulo
item.description: President Lula visited the new IFSP campus in Cidade Tiradentes, São Paulo, highlighting the expansion of federal education in high-demand areas. Earlier, he attended the Unifesp campus in Itaquera, which will house the Institute of Cities. Cabinet members joined the events.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede prisão de coordenador da Secom por incentivo à fake news sobre N. S. Aparecida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested preventive arrest of George Marques, coordinator of the Presidential Communication Secretariat, for encouraging the spread of fake news about the PL's support for removing the patron saint title of Our Lady of Aparecida. The post, later deleted, encouraged sharing false information. The case arises in the 2026 electoral context.

item.title: Garoto-propaganda de bet, Davi Brito se desespera com fim das apostas
item.description: Influencer Davi Brito criticized President Lula's decision to end regulated betting in Brazil, claiming it will strengthen the illegal market and that addicted players need treatment. He defended the existing regulation as a way to protect players and questioned the effectiveness of prohibition.

item.title: Um dia após proibição das bets, Flávio chama Lula de ‘pai do Tigrinho’ durante ato no Rio
item.description: At a rally in Rio, Flávio Bolsonaro called Lula 'father of Tigrinho' and 'father of online casinos', promised to cut taxes and wage war on narcoterrorists, and claimed he will win in the first round.

item.title: Após proibição de bets, Flávio diz que Lula "está desesperado"
item.description: Following the temporary ban on sports betting (bets) in Brazil, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) accused Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) of being 'desperate' and 'sinking Brazil' during a rally in São João de Meriti. He also pledged to improve the SUS with standards similar to those of the Albert Einstein Hospital.

item.title: Meta derruba vídeo em que Freixo critica decisão de Mendonça sobre Flávio
item.description: Meta removed a video where Marcelo Freixo criticized Minister André Mendonça's decision regarding Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida. Freixo contested the action, calling it censorship, and announced he will notify the platform. The legal ruling also involved comedian Antônio Tabet.

item.title: Lula critica bets por “matar ou endividar o povo pobre”
item.description: President Lula strongly criticized sports betting (bets), calling them a practice that 'kills or indebts the poor', and signed a provisional decree banning online casinos and betting platforms in Brazil. He highlighted social risks such as debt, addiction, and suicide attempts linked to gambling, emphasizing that betting does not make anyone rich.

item.title: Zema lança jogo estilo Mario Kart com ministros, Vorcaro e Lula
item.description: Candidate Romeu Zema launched a Mario Kart-inspired game titled 'Chega de Intocáveis', featuring characters such as Lula, Daniel Vorcaro, and Supreme Court ministers. The game was released a day after the TSE ordered Zema to remove a campaign video deemed to exceed the bounds of political criticism. Zema criticized the TSE decision, calling it censorship.

item.title: O valor bilionário que os times de futebol perdem com o fim das bets
item.description: President Lula's ban on sports betting impacts 14 of the 20 Brazilian league teams, stripping away billionaire sponsorships that account for 7% of total revenue. In 2025, betting contracts moved over R$1 billion, highlighted by deals such as Flamengo x Betano (R$268 million/year).

item.title: Lula diz que tomou 'atitude muito drástica' ao proibir bets e que apostas viraram 'desgraça na vida das pessoas pobres'
item.description: President Lula defended the ban on fixed-odds betting (bets) during a campaign rally in São Paulo, arguing it leads to debt and social harm among the poor. He also contrasted pro-government candidates with businessman Daniel Vorcaro, accused of corruption.

item.title: Flávio pede prisão de servidor da Secom por fake news de Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense team requested preventive arrest of a government communications official for spreading fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida. The official allegedly shared posts containing false information about the presidential candidate. The case was forwarded to the Electoral Public Ministry.

item.title: As digitais de um diplomata e de um marqueteiro no discurso de Lula na ONU
item.description: President Lula delivered a speech at the UN carefully crafted by diplomats and campaign strategists, blending critiques of multilateralism with electoral themes such as national sovereignty and democracy defense, aiming to sway independent voters ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE passa a exigir que institutos informem uso de áudios e vídeos em pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The TSE updated the electoral polling registration system, requiring institutes to report the use of audio, video, and images during interviews, as well as the order of questions and methodological details. This change follows the controversy surrounding an AtlasIntel poll suspended at the request of Flávio Bolsonaro, raising concerns about potential influence of audiovisual content on respondents' answers.

item.title: Defesa aponta contradições de Moraes e pede liberdade para Bolsonaro
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense filed a criminal revision lawsuit at the STF, requesting his release on bail and questioning decisions by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The lawyers point out alleged contradictions in the Supreme Court's handling of the case. The lawsuit seeks to analyze potential irregularities in the processes against the former president.

item.title: Lula sobre bets: "Quem quiser ganhar dinheiro arrume um jeito honesto"
item.description: President Lula criticized online betting houses and casinos, stating that those who wish to get rich should seek honest ways to earn money rather than exploiting the vulnerable. He highlighted social programs like Pé-de-Meia and Gás do Povo, and attacked Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him a swindler.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula discursa na inauguração do IFSP Cidade Tiradentes
item.description: Lula spoke at the inauguration of the new IFSP campus in Cidade Tiradentes, São Paulo. Earlier, he visited Unifesp construction sites and participated in higher education events in the area.

item.title: Bets, Desenrola e Bolsa Família: com medidas às vésperas das eleições, Orçamento de 2027 precisará de reajuste de até R$ 42,3 bi
item.description: Measures announced by Lula ahead of the 2026 elections may impact up to R$42.3 billion in public accounts for 2027, requiring budget adjustments. Key actions include an increase in Bolsa Família, a ban on online betting, and the new Desenrola 3.0 package.

item.title: Flávio aciona Procuradoria Eleitoral contra 29 perfis por fake news
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed an electoral complaint against 29 profiles for spreading fake news about allegedly intending to remove Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. The Electoral Prosecutor's Office is investigating the origin and authorship of the posts, which reached over 21 million views. Minister André Mendonça deemed the claim 'notoriously unfounded,' and Bolsonaro denied the allegations, blaming the PT for creating the story.

item.title: Governo prepara reunião com clubes para tentar conter revolta no futebol com fim das bets
item.description: President Lula summons football clubs to discuss impacts of online betting ban, which generates monthly revenue of R$800 million. The measure seeks to contain criticism ahead of October elections, with possible financial aid to teams.

item.title: El presidente Lula prohíbe las apuestas ‘online’ en la recta final de la reñida campaña electoral en Brasil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva banned online betting through a decree signed nine days before the municipal elections, arguing to tackle the debt and addiction crisis caused by digital gambling. The measure, supported by two-thirds of the population, aims to attract votes amid a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro in the polls.

item.title: 'Amor' por Vorcaro explica omissão de Alcolumbre
item.description: The government leader in the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil - AP), was linked to the influence scandal involving Congressman Daniel Vorcaro following questionable actions during his term. Vorcaro's song 'Amor' would be an indirect criticism of Alcolumbre. The post was published on September 26, 2026.

item.title: Zezé diz esperar que Brasil esteja “totalmente do lado direito”
item.description: Singer Zezé Di Camargo stated during a show in Frutal (MG) that he hopes Brazil will be 'totally on the right side', referencing the death of Rick Sollo, associating the phrase with being a good person. Zezé emphasized he rearranged his schedule to honor his late friend, who died in a helicopter crash in Santa Catarina. Historically, the singer has supported politicians from different backgrounds, such as Lula in 2002 and later Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: A omissão do governo Lula ao tentar faturar com a proibição das bets
item.description: President Lula announced a ban on online betting (bets) through a Provisional Measure, aiming to gain electoral advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro. His campaign emphasized the stance but omitted that the government had regulated bets in 2023. The move reflects increased electoral announcements in the final stretch.

item.title: Kássio Nunes Marques exige que institutos de pesquisa informem sobre uso de áudios e vídeos
item.description: TSE President Kássio Nunes Marques changed the electoral research registration system to require institutes to report the use of audio, video, and images in questionnaires, as well as the order of questions. The changes aim for greater transparency following the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll over alleged vote induction via unregistered media.

item.title: MP do Desenrola cria multa de até R$ 500 milhões para setor de combustíveis
item.description: MP 1.393, which created the Desenrola Brasil 3.0 program, establishes fines of up to R$500 million for fuel sector companies that raise prices or refuse sales without just cause. The rule, which amends the Consumer Defense Code, aims to curb price increases at gas stations and fuel distribution, intensifying government action against practices deemed abusive in the sector. ANP and Senacon have already imposed multi-million fines on companies for abusive increases.

item.title: A campanha de Lula e as 'mudanças' para o Lula 4
item.description: A faction within Lula's core team advocates for the campaign to emphasize the change narrative, citing research showing the Brazilian public's desire for transformation. The strategy aims to attract voters seeking renewal. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: O valor da multa que Lula impôs às bets que descumprirem as regras do fim das apostas
item.description: The Lula government establishes, through Temporary Measure No. 1,394, a daily fine of R$200,000 for betting companies that fail to comply with the rules for ending operations, potentially reaching R$1 million in five days. Platforms must disable access to websites and apps and block new deposits, with a 30-day deadline for regulation and extinction of authorizations.

item.title: Governo Lula prorroga por 30 dias subsídio de R$ 2,12 por litro do diesel
item.description: The Lula administration extended by 30 days the diesel subsidy of R$2.12 per liter, maintaining the full subsidy amount. The measure aims to offset international oil price volatility, worsened by the Iran conflict.

item.title: Em carreata em SP, Lula capitaliza com fim das bets e cita 'quadrilha' de Flávio
item.description: During a campaign rally in São Paulo, Lula criticized Flávio Bolsonaro by linking him to the Master Bank and praised the decree ending sports betting and virtual casinos. He also used the event to support Fernando Haddad and Senate candidates.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pregará voto útil na última semana antes do primeiro turno
item.description: In the final week before the first round of the 2026 elections, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) re-election campaign intensifies its call for strategic voting, particularly at events with business leaders in São Paulo. The message focuses on the economy and preventing fragmentation of the progressive vote.

item.title: A ‘goleada’ de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data poll shows President Lula leading the presidential race in Ceará with 60% of voting intentions, over thirty points ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro at 26%. The survey, conducted between September 21 and 24 with 1,600 voters, indicates strong consolidation of PT's leadership in the Northeast. In a hypothetical runoff, Lula would maintain a significant lead (63% vs 28%).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro quer prisão de servidor da Secom por incentivar fake news sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense filed a criminal complaint against George Marques da Silva, a Secom official, requesting preventive arrest for spreading false news about Our Lady of Aparecida. The debunked rumor claimed Flávio would support removing the title of patron saint. The complaint accuses him of spreading false information, incitement, and criminal association.

item.title: A uma semana das eleições, governo Lula manda WhatsApp pedindo que apostadores retirem valores de sites de aposta
item.description: One week before the 2026 election, the federal government, through its official WhatsApp channel, urged citizens who have funds on betting sites to withdraw their money by October 5, the day after the first-round vote. The request follows the signing of a provisional decree by President Lula banning online betting nationwide, aimed at curbing household debt. Platforms will remain active solely for withdrawals, while companies blocking withdrawals will face sanctions.

item.title: Como a oposição reagiu à decisão de Lula sobre as bets no Brasil
item.description: The opposition, led by Flávio Bolsonaro and allies, harshly criticized the Lula government over the ban on online betting, accusing the president of being the 'father of bets' for having regulated the practice in 2023. The measure, announced on April 25, includes immediate blocking of new bets and deposits on platforms, along with advertising restrictions for the sector. Opponents highlight contradictions in Lula's speech, suggesting he may resume betting after the 2026 elections.

item.title: Vorcaro: ‘Vou estar no almoço com Gonet. Gilmar deve estar’
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, former head of Banco Master, was quoted in messages to lawyer Ciro Soares about attending a lunch with prosecutorgeneral Paulo Gonet and possibly Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, part of a scandal leading to an investigation against STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Vorcaro also participated in events linked to Bolsonaro allies such as Fábio Faria and maintained contact with former Minister Ricardo Lewandowski, hired as a consultant by the bank.

item.title: Apostas como 'vilãs' e golpe no futebol: como a imprensa internacional noticiou a proibição das bets por Lula
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional decree banning online betting in Brazil, announced just days before the 2026 elections. International press highlighted the electoral weight of the measure, linking it to household debt and its impact on Brazilian football.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio diz que Lula reage à pressão sobre endividamento com fim de bets e minimiza ganho eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign team claims they can offset any political gain Lula may have by ending the bets, by convincing voters that the PT leader's move is a pressure-driven response to a problem caused by his own government. The strategy aims to reinforce the narrative that Lula only acts to fix issues created by his administration.

item.title: Petista pede afastamento de Nunes Marques e Mendonça do TSE
item.description: Federal deputy Rui Falcão (PT-SP) requested the temporary recusal of STF justices Kassio Nunes Marques and André Mendonça from the TSE, anticipating the ruling of key electoral lawsuits shaping the 2026 scenario.

item.title: De redutos aos maiores colégios eleitorais: como Lula traça o mapa da campanha?
item.description: President Lula visits major electoral college strongholds in his reelection campaign, holding 19 events across 12 states and the Federal District before the October 4 first round. He emphasizes alliances and PT consolidation, with heavy focus on the Southeast region.

item.title: Governo prorroga subvenção ao diesel por mais 30 dias, às vésperas da eleição
item.description: The federal government extended the diesel subsidy by an additional 30 days, maintaining the subvention at R$ 2.12 per liter, just under a month before the 2026 presidential election. The measure aims to mitigate the impact of rising international oil prices and price volatility in the fuel market. The extension was formalized through a decree signed by the Minister of Finance, Dario Durigan.

item.title: Mercadante tira férias do BNDES para se dedicar à campanha de Lula
item.description: Aloizio Mercadante, president of BNDES, decided to take a leave of absence starting September 28, 2026, to fully commit to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign. The move follows discussions with the campaign coordinator, Edinho Silva, to bolster the strategy for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis neste fim de semana (26 e 27)
item.description: Presidential candidates hold campaign events in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, and Paraná, with walks, rallies, interviews, and debates scheduled for Saturday and Sunday. The presidential debates are streamed live by the podcasts Kritikê and Três Irmãos, along with My News radio.

item.title: Bets prometem ir à Justiça contra proibição do governo Lula
item.description: The ANJL announced it will take legal action to reverse the Lula government's ban on betting sites, deeming the measure to be election-related. The association also demands compensation for amounts paid by companies and investments made in the country.

item.title: Zezé Di Camargo politiza morte de Rick em show: "Do lado direito de Deus"
item.description: Zezé Di Camargo faced backlash for politicizing Rick Sollo's death, a victim of an aeronautical accident, by claiming the singer is 'on God's right side' and suggesting Brazil should follow the same political direction. His remarks during a performance sparked negative reactions on social media, with accusations of using the tragedy for electoral purposes. The crash in Santa Catarina resulted in five deaths, including Rick Sollo, with adverse weather conditions being investigated as a possible cause.

item.title: Inglaterra x Espanha: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: England and Spain face off in the opening round of the Nations League 2026/27 on Saturday, 26, at 15:45 (Brasília time), at Wembley. England aims to build on its World Cup semifinal run, while Spain, fresh from winning the World Cup, celebrates recent triumphs in Euro 2024 and Nations League 2023.

item.title: Lula veta bets e Flávio passa recibo
item.description: The Lula government banned online betting through a provisional decree, a measure approved by 78% of the population, especially among women. Flávio Bolsonaro from PL criticized the initiative but avoided taking a clear stance, exposing his alliance with betting interests.

item.title: Em boas democracias, juízes não entram em campo
item.description: The article criticizes judicial actions that criminalize the opposition by accusing them of foreign interference and threats to democracy to silence criticism. It warns of the risk of stealth authoritarianism through the selective judicialization of politics. The text advocates respect for democratic rules and the role of judges outside the electoral arena.
